Images inside specified tags stay inline

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"p\"]}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Text <img src='icon.png' alt='icon'> more text</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
